title: The Gospel of Thomas
dateDisplay: Composed c. 50–200 CE; the Coptic manuscript is c. 350 CE
attributionNote: Attribution is traditional or disputed. The catalogue records the attribution as a claim in the tradition, not as a settled fact.
description: A collection of 114 sayings attributed to Jesus, found at Nag Hammadi in 1945 and known in part from Greek fragments at Oxyrhynchus. It has no narrative of the passion, and its sayings are often read as wisdom teaching with Gnostic elements.
availabilityNote: Catalogue record only. The standard English translations (Lambdin; Patterson and Meyer) are in copyright, and no public-domain translation of the complete Coptic text has been verified. The text is not reproduced here.
